comments.text: Closing as YAGNI. Premise is still factually accurate (manual emit via `Telemetry.request_start/2` + `request_stop/3` in `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/telemetry.ex`, no shared ref between start/stop), but no current consumer needs the correlation — compaction, TUI footer, cost tracking, and session persistence all read tokens off `:stop` alone, and Tracer logs events independently. Reopen when a consumer (latency analytics, request-lifecycle dashboard) actually needs it; the fix is small (switch to `:telemetry.span/3` or thread a `make_ref()` through metadata).

description: Both OpenAI and Anthropic producers emit :request, :start and :request, :stop telemetry events, but there is no shared correlation ID to tie them together. The decoder captures the provider's response_id (OpenAI's 'id' / Anthropic's 'message.id') on the message object, but it never reaches telemetry.\n\nFix: Add a unique request_id (e.g. generated at :start time) to both start and stop events as metadata, so downstream consumers can correlate token counts with their corresponding request lifecycle.
title: Add request correlation ID to AI telemetry events
